metadata.scenario_context: A team is working on a project with a critical deadline in early May. It is currently April 29th, and they must decide how to manage their workload over the next few days.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Netherlands place great importance on Leisure time.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Netherlands place great importance on Leisure time.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss  the possibility of working on April 30th- May 1st  to  complete the tasks.
agent_1.goal_2: Suggest working on May 1st to meet the deadline.

agent_2.goal_1: Discuss the remaining tasks and how to distribute the workload efficiently.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether working on May 1st is feasible.
